name: Grip squeeze
summary: Squeeze a soft ball as hard as is comfortable, hold, relax.
setup: Hold a soft ball or putty in the palm. Squeeze, hold five seconds, relax fully.
why: The fingers do all the work. Logged by hand.
contraindications: Pain in the fingers or a recent hand fracture without clearance.

faults.label: Holding the breath
faults.tip: Breath-holding spikes blood pressure during a hard grip. Keep breathing out.

faults.label: Wrist bending on the squeeze
faults.tip: Keep the wrist neutral so the fingers do the work.

faults.label: Curling the wrist
faults.tip: A neutral wrist puts the work in the hand rather than the forearm tendons.
